fields.label: Data Store Ids
fields.help: The data stores associated with this engine.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The display name of the engine.

fields.label: Engine ID
fields.help: The ID to use for chat engine.

fields.label: Industry Vertical
fields.help: The industry vertical that the chat engine registers.

fields.label: Allow Cross Region
fields.help: If the flag set to true, we allow the agent and engine are in different locations, otherwise the agent and engine are required to be in the same location.

fields.label: Dialogflow Agent To Link
fields.help: The resource name of an existing Dialogflow agent to link to this Chat Engine.

fields.label: Agent Creation Config
Business
fields.help: Name of the company, organization or other entity that the agent represents.

fields.label: Default Language Code
fields.help: The default language of the agent as a language tag.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Agent location for Agent creation, currently supported values: global/us/eu, it needs to be the same region as the Chat Engine.

fields.label: Time Zone
fields.help: The time zone of the agent from the [time zone database](https://www.iana.org/time-zones), e.g., America/New_York, Europe/Paris.
The configuration to generate the Dialogflow agent that is associated to this Engine.

fields.label: Common Config
Company Name
fields.help: The name of the company, business or entity that is associated with the engine.
Common config spec that specifies the metadata of the engine.
